name: imate Missions
skill_list: Uses the Star Wars Collectible Miniatures Game skirmish rules, presents new advanced rules, and provides guidelines for creating your own missions.</
Includes a two-sided poster map (featuring Mos Eisley and Cloud City), and one sheet of terrain tile cutouts.
Missions allow for solo, one-on-one, tag-team, and multiplayer battles, with campaign links that allow you to follow the epic struggle of the Rebellion against the Galactic Empire.
Features 33 missions that span across A New Hope, The Empire Strikes Back, and Return of the Jedi.

name: imate Missions

Features 36 missions that span across Episode I: The Phantom Menace, Episode II: Attack of the Clones and the Clone Wars cartoon series.
